column6: A person 亻 rén lowered toward the base/ground 氐 dī, which also gives the sound → 低 dī “low; lower, bow down.”
Fine silk 糸 mì gives the meaning; 囟 xìn “fontanelle, soft spot on a baby's skull” gives the sound → 細 xì “fine, thin”; 囟 later changed graphically to 田, and 糹 was simplified to 纟 → 细.
An arrow 矢 shǐ served as a straight standard for judging length; 豆 dòu “ritual vessel; bean” gives the sound → 短 duǎn “short.”
A cart 車 chē with padded, softened wheels; 耎 ruǎn “soft, weak” gives the sound → 輭 ruǎn “soft,” later written 軟 and simplified to 软.
A house 宀 mián gives the meaning “spacious”; 萈 huán “slender-horned mountain goat” gives the sound → 寬 kuān “wide, spacious”; simplified to 宽.
